usage: pgvamp-ofdm evaluate [-h] [--config CONFIG] --manifest MANIFEST
                            [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT]
                            [--algorithms {mmse,vamp,pg_vamp} [{mmse,vamp,pg_vamp} ...]]
                            [--device DEVICE] [--dtype DTYPE] [--seed SEED]
                            [--allow-untrained] --output OUTPUT
                            [--bootstrap-seed BOOTSTRAP_SEED]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --manifest MANIFEST
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
  --algorithms {mmse,vamp,pg_vamp} [{mmse,vamp,pg_vamp} ...]
  --device DEVICE
  --dtype DTYPE
  --seed SEED           test seed; must match pre-generated manifest
  --allow-untrained
  --output OUTPUT
  --bootstrap-seed BOOTSTRAP_SEED

usage: pgvamp-ofdm benchmark [-h] [--config CONFIG] --manifest MANIFEST
                             [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT]
                             [--algorithms {mmse,vamp,pg_vamp} [{mmse,vamp,pg_vamp} ...]]
                             [--device DEVICE] [--dtype DTYPE] [--seed SEED]
                             [--allow-untrained] --output OUTPUT
                             [--timing-mode {per_observation_cold_H,same_H_amortized,both}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --manifest MANIFEST
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
  --algorithms {mmse,vamp,pg_vamp} [{mmse,vamp,pg_vamp} ...]
  --device DEVICE
  --dtype DTYPE
  --seed SEED           test seed; must match pre-generated manifest
  --allow-untrained
  --output OUTPUT
  --timing-mode {per_observation_cold_H,same_H_amortized,both}

usage: pgvamp-ofdm report [-h] --results RESULTS [RESULTS ...]
                          [--output OUTPUT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --results RESULTS [RESULTS ...]
  --output OUTPUT
